title: Adopt IMP-410: commit-msg accepts a pure Nous sync via scripts/nous-sync-owns.mjs

outcomes.statement: A commit that is exactly a Nous sync (consistent delivery envelope, every other staged path claimed in .nous-sync.json at its delivered hash under the substrate-managed allowlist, clean-tree provenance) is accepted by commit-msg without a US/CHG work id.
outcomes.demo: Stage a real Nous sync and commit it with no work id; node scripts/nous-sync-owns.mjs --staged exits 0 and the hook accepts it (proven on 86d1ba8).

outcomes.statement: Every other commit keeps today's behaviour: a work id is required and work-readiness check-staged still runs.
outcomes.demo: Stage a non-sync change and run the hook with a message lacking a work id; it is rejected with the existing traceability error.

uncertainties.statement: Whether an early exit for sync commits weakens the readiness gate for non-sync commits.
uncertainties.resolution: The exit is taken only when nous-sync-owns exits 0; any violation falls through to the unchanged traceability and check-staged path. Output is silenced so ordinary commits see no new noise.

actuals.root_cause: Rounded operator-session reconstruction. Readiness 8 minutes covers the artifact, the digest-bound decision, and the readiness-bound plan the gate required before the hook commit. Implementation 2 minutes is the 11-line guarded block in .githooks/commit-msg. Focused verification 3 minutes: the range predicate on 86d1ba8 and the negative hook control. Integration 5 minutes: approval, plan, implementation and evidence commits. No mutation campaign: the change is a bash hook with no mutatable TypeScript (0 shards). The sync it enables was proven before this CHG on 86d1ba8.
